ping_2019.source: PING Optimal Launch & Spin Chart (2019) (Anchor 4, Source 2)

driver.rule: launch band = [min(sources) - margin, max(sources) + margin]; same for spin. Sources are read by bilinear interpolation clamped to each grid: TrackMan at (club speed, attack angle), PING at (ball speed of the ideal delivery at that club speed, attack angle).

trackman_carry_2010.source: TrackMan Driver Fitting Chart (2010), CARRY Optimizer (Anchor 4, Source 1)

known_exceptions.note: Model ideal preset (path 0, face 0) falls outside its own band. The LPGA Tour average launches below both driver optimizers, and the model reproduces the published row.

scaling.ball_speed_mph: target = smash * club_speed, half-width ball_speed_frac of the target
scaling.carry_yd: simulate the preset delivery at the current club speed with the preset spin trim, half-width carry_frac of that carry
scaling.fixed: Every other band keeps its preset-speed value. Open sides are null.
scaling.note: Bands are computed at the preset club speed and attack angle. Two families move with the player's club speed, and the page recomputes them live with the model.
scaling.side_yd_curve_yd: half-width side_frac and curve_frac of the scaled carry

sources.attack_deg: MODELED: model preset output for this club and player +-1.5 deg
sources.ball_speed_mph: MODELED: ideal delivery scaled to the current club speed +-3 percent
sources.carry_yd: MODELED: ideal delivery scaled to the current club speed +-3 percent
sources.club_speed_mph: MODELED: preset club speed +-5 percent, informational
sources.curve_yd: MODELED: straight target shot, 4 percent of carry
sources.dyn_loft_deg: MODELED: model preset output for this club and player +-2 deg
sources.face_deg: MODELED: straight target shot, face to target +-1 deg
sources.face_to_path_deg: MODELED: straight target shot, face to path +-1.5 deg
sources.land_angle_deg: MODELED: model preset output for this club and player, at least preset minus 3 deg
sources.launch_deg: MODELED: model preset output for this club and player +-1.5 deg
sources.launch_deg_driver: TrackMan Carry Optimizer 2010 and PING 2019, read at the current club speed, ball speed and attack angle (values in detail). Band runs from the lower source minus 1 deg to the higher plus 1 deg (MODELED margin).
sources.launch_dir_deg: TrackMan, What is Launch Direction? (keep within ±2 degrees)
sources.max_height_yd: MODELED: model preset output for this club and player +-3 yd
sources.path_deg: MODELED: straight target shot, path +-2 deg
sources.side_yd: MODELED: straight target shot, 5 percent of carry
sources.smash: MODELED: model preset output for this club and player, at least preset minus 0.03
sources.spin_axis_deg: TrackMan, What is Spin Axis? (-2 to 2 counts as straight)
sources.spin_loft_deg: MODELED: model preset output for this club and player +-2 deg
sources.spin_rpm: MODELED: model preset output for this club and player +-10 percent
sources.spin_rpm_driver: TrackMan Carry Optimizer 2010 and PING 2019, read at the current club speed, ball speed and attack angle (values in detail). Band runs from the lower source minus 200 rpm to the higher plus 200 rpm (MODELED margin).
